title: Preserving Cultural Identity with Context-Aware Translation Through Multi-Agent AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of translated outputs against a baseline model (GPT-4o) across specific cultural contexts (festivals, religion, and history), as well as automated validation using an agent that cross-references text with external search engines (DuckDuckGo) to detect cultural misrepresentations and distortions.

Evaluating the retention of idiomatic expressions, regional nuances, and contextual depth in translations for non-Western and low-resource languages (Hindi, Turkish, Hebrew) to counteract English-centric model tendencies.
